$comment: Codebases nobody here maintains, folded through both implementations as their own rows (#129). Each is read at the pinned revision by scripts/fetch-corpus-external.sh; nothing is vendored. Every directory holding a chant.config.ts is one entry.

checkouts.name: jhgaylor/home-cloud
checkouts.note: A home Kubernetes estate: sixteen apps and a platform aggregate, each with its own chant.config.ts and build parameters, on the k8s lexicon. Written against chant 0.44.

checkouts.name: jhgaylor/infisical-chant
checkouts.note: An Infisical deployment on the k8s lexicon with a project rule under .chant/rules. Written against chant 0.19, before composites. Its params.ts, a declarator calling a project function that reads process.env, is where chant#2453 was found; since chant 0.72.3 both implementations run it.
